newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-ATI rated buy by Angping.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ATI rated buy by Angping.

text.p: Angping & Associates on Friday recommended a buy on port operator Asian Terminals Inc (ATI) due to its strong earnings potential.
Analyst Jason King said in a report that the ongoing rehabilitation and expansion projects by the company would further boost its efficiency and capacity.

The company registered a 19 percent rise in container volume to 261,569 twenty foot equivalent units (TEUs) during the first half of its fiscal year 1996-1997 from 220,000 TEU in the same period the previous year. Its year ends in June.
King added that its grains terminal located north of Manila is also projected to make 62 million pesos of net profits for this fiscal year.

"The potential earnings promised by its Inland Clearance Depot in Calamba and its Port of Batangas operations, makes ATI very appealing. It is currently trading at 17.1 times as compared to (its competitor ICTSI) which is trading at a higher price-earnings ratio of 23.9 times," he said.
